text:
Morgan: quick ping — PR 8421 adds toolcall header forwarding + a fallback path for the Go SDK. can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/8421
Morgan: main change is in client.go and stream/handler.go, plus a small e2e smoke test. expect small API surface impact.
Lee: @Morgan on my list, will try to take a pass this afternoon.
ci-bot: build succeeded on commit 4f2d3a (linux, mac) :white_check_mark:
Sam: skimmed the diff, one question: why are we mutating `ctx` in client.go? looks like that could race for concurrent calls.
Morgan: good catch — that was a lazy shortcut. i'll refactor to create a shallow copy of the request metadata and push a fix now.
Nora: left a couple tiny nits inline (naming + comment). overall lgtm after the ctx change and CI green. :thumbsup:
Lee: i pulled and ran the local smoke: `make e2e-go` timed out intermittently — looks flakey, added a retry to the test harness and re-ran.
Morgan: pushed retry + shallow-copy fix, kicked CI.
ci-bot: rerun queued for PR 8421 — tests will run in ~5m.
Lee: i'll re-run my local once CI is green, plan to approve after that. @Sam @Nora if you two can re-check the header merge logic quickly that'd be great.
Sam: will re-review in ~30m and flag anything obvious.
Nora: if Sam is tight on time, ok to defer to Lee for final approval after CI.
Morgan: thanks all — i'll hold off merge until we see green circle. appreciate the quick eyes! :pray:
